# runr_project_access (Resource)

A role for a user or a group on one project only (project access). The role's project-scoped permissions apply to that project; organization-wide roles cover every project already. Needs `projects.manage_access` on the project. A user or group holds one role per project: a second resource for the same subject changes the role of the same grant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A role on one project only, for a user ...
resource "runr_project_access" "grace" {
  project_id = runr_project.orders.id
  user       = "grace@example.com" # user id, e-mail address or username
  role       = "developer"
}

# ... or for a group.
resource "runr_project_access" "auditors" {
  project_id = runr_project.orders.id
  group_id   = runr_group.auditors.id
  role       = "viewer"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Project id.
- `role` (String) Role key on the project (built-in such as `developer` or `viewer`, or `runr_role.<name>.key`). The Owner role is given to members directly only.

### Optional

- `group_id` (String) The group (`runr_group.<name>.id`).
- `user` (String) The user, by id, e-mail address or username. Exactly one of `user` and `group_id`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Grant id.
- `subject_id` (String) User or group id.
- `subject_type` (String) `user` or `group`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project name or id>/<grant id> (`runr access ls -p <project>` lists the grant ids)
terraform import runr_project_access.grace orders-api/01JABCDEF0123456789ABCDEFG
```
